artifact.core.pendantOfCourage.descripti:
{Pendant of Courage}

When worn, this item bestows {+2 Luck} and {+2 Morale} to your hero's troops.
artifact.core.pendantOfCourage.name: Pendant of Courage
skill.core.luck.description.advanced:
{Advanced Luck}

Increases the Luck of all hero's creatures by {2}, improving their chance to deal double damage with lucky strikes.

{Positive Luck} can grant or improve chance-based creature abilities. {Negative Luck} can weaken such abilities.

Additionally, it increases the chance of better rewards from adventure map objects. In creature banks, at this level it provides a {50%} chance for an upgraded reward. In the Pyramid, it provides a {50%} chance to discover an additional random level 4 spell if the hero has {Expert Wisdom}.
